releases.title: Plato meets Pluto
notes: A new golden, dark look. Your plate is now Pluto, photographed by NASA's New Horizons.
Sunlight moves across Pluto as you log toward your daily target. It glows when you're on target and turns a little rusty if you go over.
Collect Pluto's five moons, from Charon to Styx, by logging days in a row.

releases.title: Edit your meals
notes: Logged something wrong? Tap any food on the Today screen (or the pencil icon) to fix its name, meal, calories, protein, carbs, fat and more.
Ate more or less than you logged? Use the ½× to 2× buttons to scale the whole entry at once.
Plato now tells you when a new version is out. Tap Update to get it, and you'll see what changed.

releases.title: Plato launches
notes: Snap a photo or describe your food to estimate calories and nutrients.
A personal calorie and macro target based on your body, activity and goal.
Workout plans with a 3D coach, plus weight and calorie progress charts.
